title: Guard requirements where glazing in a window sits below the minimum guard height (listed ON HOLD in catalogue)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: January 2026 (platform created January 20, 2026, last updated January 30, 2026)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies how guard requirements apply when glazing in a window is positioned below the minimum guard height in NBC(AE).
The Discussion states that NBC(AE) generally requires a guard where there is an elevation difference of 600 mm or more.
When a window is located within a wall, the window is considered part of that wall assembly.
If the bottom sill is below the minimum guard height with a 600 mm or greater elevation difference, the window must either be designed as a guard or be protected with a guard.
